yontem.ne: Sosyal medya biyografilerinden doğrulanmış e-postaları ve iletişim bilgilerini toplar.
yontem.alinti: Scout is a free tool that finds verified emails from social media bios.

akis.alinti: It scrapes profiles from Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and five other platforms
then pulls out emails, phone numbers, and links.
After scraping, it verifies each email by checking with the mail server and scores how likely it is to be valid.

akis.ne: Komut satırından çalıştırma ve dışa aktarma
akis.alinti: You run it from your terminal with one command, and it exports everything to a CSV.

yazi: git clone https://github.com/kiryano/Scout.git cd Scout pip install -r requirements.txt cp .env.example .env python scout.py python scout.py --verbose python scout.py --version python scout.py --help python3.10+
